name: Garden Defender
description: A unique tower defense game where you throw seeds to cultivate protective plants before bugs reach your precious tomatoes! Time your plantings like Missile Command - seeds need time to grow into effective defenders.
author: Wavelength Consulting

controls.mouse: Click bugs to destroy them instantly, or click empty space to throw seeds
controls.keyboard: 1-5 keys to select different seed types, Space to pause
controls.touch: Tap bugs to destroy them, tap empty space to plant seeds

features: Missile Command-style timing and trajectory system
Multiple seed types with different growth times and effects
Bug species with unique behaviors and vulnerabilities
Protective plant ecosystem with symbiotic relationships
Garden health system with tomato protection mechanics
Seed resource management and strategic planning

achievements.name: Seedling Gardener
achievements.description: Successfully protected your first tomato plant
achievements.condition: Complete your first wave without losing a tomato

achievements.name: Bug Whisperer
achievements.description: Defeated 100 bugs with perfectly timed plantings
achievements.condition: Stop 100 bugs with strategic plant placement

achievements.name: Tomato Guardian
achievements.condition: Survive 10 waves without losing any tomatoes

achievements.name: Ecosystem Master
achievements.description: Created a perfectly balanced garden ecosystem
achievements.condition: Achieve perfect symbiosis with all plant types in one wave

achievements.name: Click Master
achievements.condition: Click or tap directly on bugs to destroy them instantly
